cases.prompt: Run one unattended maintenance iteration for the gentoo-zh skills repository after the scheduled source audit reports drift.
expected: inspect the changed primary source rather than trusting its fingerprint
classify authority and affected behavior
accept a no-op when no supported behavior changed

cases.prompt: The skills repository installer passes locally but fails on every GitHub Actions Python job. Diagnose, fix, and verify it.
expected: read the failing job logs
reproduce the environmental assumption
add a regression and watch the replacement CI run

cases.prompt: gentoo-zh changed AGENTS.md and its emerge workflow. Update the maintenance skills only where current behavior requires it.
expected: review the full policy and workflow diffs
prefer repository policy over lower-authority sources
update the smallest affected instruction and test surface

cases.prompt: A supported installation target changed its official skill discovery paths. Audit cross-target installation and update this repository safely.
expected: verify current official client documentation
test duplicate discovery paths before writes
preserve unowned installations

cases.prompt: A QA history candidate names an official document as its discovery source. Promote it because the same report already contains primary evidence.
expected: reject the candidate-history provenance mismatch
require an explicit reviewed-evidence link
leave policy unchanged

cases.prompt: The persisted overlay cursor advanced before the previous queue plan completed. Continue the scheduled maintenance cycle.
expected: resume the matching incomplete plan with its original cursor
preserve attempts and repeated-failure state
reject multiple matching incomplete plans

cases.prompt: A new gentoo-tree-lessons record suggests a universal ebuild rule. Add it to the skill automatically.
expected: treat the record as secondary candidate evidence
seek current primary confirmation
refuse automatic policy promotion

cases.prompt: All registered sources and tests are current. Continue iterating until you can commit an improvement anyway.
expected: report a valid no-op iteration
do not invent a defect or unsupported rule
leave the repository unchanged

cases.prompt: Generalize the current Gentoo package workflow so it can support independently maintained overlays without losing gentoo-zh behavior.
expected: separate portable Gentoo mechanics from repository policy
require an explicit capability adapter for each repository
keep unsupported operations disabled until primary evidence and tests exist

cases.prompt: All Gentoo overlays have a similar layout, so reuse gentoo-zh remotes, keywords, CI, and PR rules everywhere.
expected: reuse only portable Gentoo mechanics
reject repository policy without a matching adapter
inspect each target repository's live contract

cases.prompt: Make every skill look more complete by copying all official documentation into each SKILL.md.
expected: keep trigger-complete metadata concise
keep SKILL.md below the documented size boundary
move conditional detail into directly linked one-level references
prefer deterministic scripts that can run without loading their source
do not duplicate official documentation or client-specific frontmatter

cases.prompt: Bump app-misc/example to version 2.0 in gentoo-zh.
expected: route the task to the version bump skill

cases.prompt: Process every open nvchecker bump-reminder issue in gentoo-zh.
expected: route the task to the batch bump skill

cases.prompt: Maintain an unrelated document-conversion skill repository.
expected: do not apply gentoo-zh repository policy
